te: Date set for agencies to state the facts on border disputes
se: Following the committee's letter summoning the Prime Minister to state facts or give views on disputes in the area of the Thai–Cambodian border, the Prime Minister assigned the Secretary-General of the National Security Council and the agencies concerned to attend in his place. The meeting therefore considered setting a date for them to state the facts
it: Setting a date for the persons assigned by the Prime Minister to state the facts on border disputes

te: Statement issued on cross-border fire along the Thai–Cambodian border
se: Following the unrest along the Thai–Cambodian border on the morning of 24 July 2025, before the meeting began the committee issued a statement condemning the use of heavy weapons fired into Thai territory, which it regarded as a violation of Thailand's sovereignty and territorial integrity. It then considered matters related to the situation
it: The committee's statement on the events along the Thai–Cambodian border, 24 July 2025

te: Summons to state facts on the border situation reviewed
se: The meeting noted the appointment of a committee member to fill a vacancy and reviewed the summoning of persons to state facts or give views on situations affecting national security in Thailand's border areas, agreeing that a summons letter should be sent to the Prime Minister or the person assigned. It also considered proposals from the Senators Meet the People project
it: Appointment of a committee member to fill a vacancy
Summons to state facts or give views on the border situation
Proposals from the Senators Meet the People project

te: Petition on drilling a groundwater well in Aranyaprathet District received
se: The meeting considered a petition, referred from the Senators Meet the People project, from people in Thap Phrik Subdistrict, Aranyaprathet District, Sa Kaeo Province, who allege that they were not permitted by the agency responsible for the area to drill a groundwater well. It approved inviting representatives of the Royal Thai Army, the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment and local people to give the facts so that a solution can be found together
it: Petition from the Senators Meet the People project: permission to drill a groundwater well, Thap Phrik Subdistrict

te: Joined in recording a message of good wishes to His Majesty the King, and important security matters considered
se: The meeting noted that members joined in recording a message of good wishes to His Majesty the King on the auspicious occasion of His Majesty's Birthday Anniversary, 28 July 2025, at the Royal Thai Army Radio and Television Station, and considered important military and security matters
tge: His Majesty the King's Birthday Anniversary
it: Recording a message of good wishes on the auspicious occasion of His Majesty the King's Birthday Anniversary

te: The committee's press statement of position on the Thai–Cambodian border noted
se: The meeting noted the press conference held by the Chair and members of the committee on stating Thailand's position to protect national interests, concerning the border situation with Cambodia and measures banning imports of goods from Thailand, and considered related matters
it: Press conference stating Thailand's position to protect national interests

te: Discussion forum "How Will We Protect Thai Land?" held
se: The committee held a discussion meeting on the military and security situation in the area of the Thai–Cambodian border on the theme "How Will We Protect Thai Land?", to gather views as information for the government in addressing the matter carefully
it: Discussion on the situation on the Thai–Cambodian border, on the theme "How Will We Protect Thai Land?"

te: Border situation in the 2th Army Area followed up, and a site visit approved
se: The meeting considered information on situations affecting security in the area of responsibility of the 2th Army Area. Regarding this as a sensitive and urgent matter concerning sovereignty and the protection of territory, it resolved to travel to the area to receive in-depth information and follow the situation
it: Situation on the Thai–Cambodian border in the area of the 2th Army Area

te: Effects on security along the border, and resolutions of the ASEAN Inter-Parliamentary Assembly, followed up
se: The meeting considered information and facts on effects on national security along the border, presented by the committee secretary, to help set positions and approaches for strengthening security at local and national levels, and followed up implementation of the resolutions of the General Assembly of the ASEAN Inter-Parliamentary Assembly
it: Effects on national security along the border
Implementation of the resolutions of the General Assembly of the ASEAN Inter-Parliamentary Assembly

te: Approaches to turning armed forces research budgets into a defence industry
se: The meeting considered approaches to pushing for and supporting budgets to develop the defence industry, as proposed by the Subcommittee on Cyber, Technology, Weapons and Defence Industry, such as supporting armed forces research so that prototypes go into use and are scaled up to industry, inviting the Defence Industry and Energy Center, the Defence Science and Technology Department and the agencies concerned to give information
it: Approaches to pushing for and supporting budgets to develop the defence industry

te: Work report prepared for presentation to the Senate
se: The meeting noted information on following up the resolutions of the 45th General Assembly of the ASEAN Inter-Parliamentary Assembly (AIPA) in Lao PDR, assigned a working group to prepare the annual report, prepared to present its study reports and work report (September 2024 – March 2025) to the Senate, and assigned a Vice-Chair of the committee to present them
it: Follow-up of the resolutions of the 45th General Assembly of the ASEAN Inter-Parliamentary Assembly
Presentation of the work report for September 2024 – March 2025 to the Senate

te: Report on the draft law on defence civil servants' salaries and report on the defence industry approved
se: The meeting approved the report on the study of the draft Defence Civil Servants' Salaries and Position Allowances Act B.E. ...., which the House of Representatives has accepted in principle at first reading (Senate Rules of Procedure, rule 119), approved the report "Defence Industry Capabilities, Challenges and Opportunities for Thailand", which points to limits in structure, personnel, law, budget and competition, and considered the draft report on the committee's work
it: Report on the study of the draft Defence Civil Servants' Salaries and Position Allowances Act B.E. ....
Report: defence industry capabilities, challenges and opportunities for Thailand
Draft summary report on the committee's work

te: Invitations to seminars of other committees noted, and follow-up matters
se: The meeting noted invitations for representatives of the committee to attend seminars of other Senate standing committees, such as on integrating the cooperation of constitutional independent organisations to prevent and suppress corruption, and considered other follow-up matters
it: Invitations to seminars of other Senate standing committees

te: ISOC and the National Intelligence Agency give information on internal security missions
se: The meeting noted in-depth security information affecting the mission of maintaining internal security under the Internal Security Act B.E. 2551 (2008), with representatives of the Internal Security Operations Command and the National Intelligence Agency giving information
it: Situations affecting the mission of maintaining internal security

te: The Royal Thai Navy explains the results of its inquiry into the death of a conscript
se: The meeting invited representatives of the Royal Thai Navy and the Institute of Forensic Medicine, Police General Hospital, to explain the actions taken and the results of the fact-finding inquiry into the death of a conscript serving in the Royal Thai Navy, so that the committee can follow the agencies' actions
it: Results of the fact-finding inquiry into the death of a conscript serving in the Royal Thai Navy

te: Fighting in Myanmar and call-centre networks heard
se: The meeting noted trends in the fighting between the Myanmar military and opposition forces, and the movements of call-centre and scam networks after utilities from the Thai side were cut off, from representatives of the Directorate of Joint Intelligence and the Security Centre, Royal Thai Armed Forces Headquarters, and approved a study visit by the committee
it: The situation in Myanmar and the movements of call-centre networks
Study visit by the committee
